questions.question: From a point 8 meters from the base of a vertical tower, the angle of elevation θ to the top satisfies tan(θ) = 3/4. How tall is the tower?
questions.explanation: C is correct. Tangent equals height divided by horizontal distance, so height = distance × tan(θ).
questions.teachingTopic: 仰角、俯角及实际测量问题
